rules.meaning: completion cap chosen where truncation is tolerable
V6-E01: a family failing C4 on its SPAN extends outward from both measured extremes, which is the only direction that can raise max(iota) - min(iota)
V6-E02: a row §12.6's criterion would silently drop is refused, so a measured rung cannot be counted ineligible for want of a join

the six determinate entries at the frozen m* are combined into the registered paired contrasts, bootstrapped over topics, read through the boundary rule and projected to the confirmatory half-width; the record decides nothing and the stage has one outcome

m* is selected once, by §12.3 at Gate 2, and this stage cannot move it. `probe_disposition` refuses a table carrying any severity but m* and returns m_star_out == m_star_in on its one path; in v7 it decides nothing else
the invariant is executed on both halves: the producing path asserts m_star_in == m_star_out before the record is written, and every downstream read checks the written record against Gate 2's own m*

a determinate entry at an exact boundary at the frozen m* is RECORDED with the statuses it puts on the contrast, and the replication continues. COMPOSED_HEADROOM_UNREACHABLE is withdrawn and no module can raise it

the probed m* must be one Gate 2 found ADMISSIBLE: eligible under §12.3 and, at that severity, adequate under §12.4 and past D17's construct floor. Eligibility alone is a band test on the solo curve, so checking only it would admit an operating point Gate 2 would itself have refused

kappa(R|B) and the §13.1 pool are read at the frozen operating point, BY NAME, from columns Gate 2 signed for every admissible severity before the probe observed a composed cell. `assert_kappa_under_b_source` refuses a table read at an operating point its column was not measured at, so a positional read cannot land on the wrong severity

the freeze binds B --- and the pool --- at the operating point the study runs, which is Gate 2's frozen m*. Confirmatory generation renders every cell from the frozen slot map, and `effective_m_star` refuses a probe record that disagrees with Gate 2 rather than following either
no function in the probe module reads a reference or a selection record, by name and by source
the high-recall retention verdict for each rung

m* is B's eligible severity nearest 0.80

§12.6's criterion re-read on the CALIBRATION basis at the iota_A reference selection matches on --- iota(R), the eligibility coordinate, the vacuity and iota_A all from the same 192 topics at the same four draws. A lost decisive condition enters §13.15 as a design-time failure under §34 D6's existing disposition; there is no drift threshold and no new status

the registered stage, the operating-point search and the development pilot evaluate ONE implementation of the support criterion. v5's development work asked whether reserve rungs land inside the solo band, which is one clause of one component of V(R), and could not predict the gate it was standing in for

§12.3's own preference over `focal_admissible`, written at Gate 2 and restricted at Gate 2.5 to the severities that can reach §13.15's five-family minimum. Nothing tries these in turn --- m* is frozen --- and the probe reads the head only, to check that Gate 2 and Gate 2.5 agree about it

§13.15's five-family minimum is evaluated at every admissible severity and recorded. The verdict is Gate 2.5's own, computed there because that stage generates nothing, so the column costs no rows and no second bootstrap. The study runs at the frozen m*; the rest is a signed prospective record that no selection rule reads

the unconstrained cell and B's own solo cell are read off the Gate-2 record instead of drawn again, and ONLY when the topic identifiers and the draw count are identical. That makes the composed lift a difference from the number m* was selected on rather than a difference between two samples of it, and the refusal to reuse across topic sets is checked rather than assumed

the probe covers every one of §13.14's ten slot-and-order exposure classes, and the partition is DERIVED from design.cells.cell_types rather than listed --- so admitting an arm or changing §8.4's order rule changes what the probe must cover without an edit to the probe. A shape that leaves a class uncovered is refused

a structural zero, an arm at an exact boundary with its Wilson allowance, and a direction compressed below the SESOI are each read off the contrast's own constituents by one function, the same one the analysis and Gate 4 call

each contrast's confirmatory half-width is projected from the measured between-topic and draw components at the registered M and block count, against its precision precondition; a projection, labelled and read by no rule
an entry of a cell containing a stand-in is classified for proximity to the descriptive band and recorded under `standin_proximity`; it enters no contrast and decides nothing

each stand-in is probed at the severity of its own solo ladder nearest Gate 2's measured iota_A inside §13.4's band, because §13.8 matches a reference's iota(R) to iota_A. iota_A does not depend on m*, so the companion a probed cell carries is fixed by a quantity the operating point cannot move

a probe_only stand-in is a registered instrument --- same verifier, same hash, same Gate-1 certification --- and is outside every selectable pool: §12.2's screen filters to SELECTABLE_FAMILY_IDS and re-asserts it rung by rung, and the tier partitions, the candidate budget and the freeze's candidate vocabulary all read the selectable pool

a registration binds two documents by hash, and a COMPLETE DRAFT is exactly what could be mistaken for a registration by being present. Both documents declare their own status and the manifest refuses while either says it is a draft; silence reads as a draft, because the safe reading of silence here is the one that refuses

a stage-1 readiness verdict is a REFUSAL, not a §28 terminal outcome. Every blocker names work a researcher has to do, so a terminating verdict made the whole vocabulary unreachable --- the first invocation that found any of it outstanding killed the replication. It writes no record and no terminal report, logs a REFUSED transition carrying the blockers, and the stage may be attempted again once the prerequisite is met. The criterion is unchanged

the pre-manifest recovery: a readiness verdict an apparatus fault wrote as a §28.3 terminal report is RETAINED under superseded/apparatus_fault/<record hash>/ and named in every registration signed afterwards. It refuses for any other gate, any §28 terminal status, once a manifest exists, once any row has been generated, and on a hash that does not match --- so it can revive nothing scientific
